name: ff-mcp-jira
description: Connects Claude to Fintech Farm Jira (https://jira.fintech-farm.com, also Atlassian Cloud). 37 tools: JQL search, issue create/update/delete, labels, transitions, comments, assignment, subtasks, issue & remote links, watchers, worklogs, sprints/boards, field & create metadata, user search, attachments, raw API.
long_description:
Connects Claude Desktop to Fintech Farm Jira (Server/DC at https://jira.fintech-farm.com, also compatible with Atlassian Cloud). Supports JQL search, issue create/update/delete, labels, transitions, comments (add/edit/delete), assignment, subtasks, issue links and remote links, watchers, worklogs, projects, issue types, field/create/edit metadata discovery, user and assignable-user search, agile boards and sprints (including move-to-sprint), attachments and raw API requests.

To get an API token: open https://jira.fintech-farm.com/secure/ViewProfile.jspa?selectedTab=com.atlassian.pats.pats-plugin:jira-user-personal-access-tokens, click "Create token", and copy it immediately.

Developed by Oleksandr Honcharov.

jira_base_url.title: Jira base URL
jira_base_url.description: Fintech Farm Jira. For Atlassian Cloud use https://your-site.atlassian.net

jira_api_token.title: API token / Personal Access Token
jira_api_token.description: Create at jira.fintech-farm.com → Profile → Personal Access Tokens → Create token, then copy it immediately. (On Atlassian Cloud, use an API token instead.)

jira_email.title: Account email (Cloud only)
jira_email.description: Required for Atlassian Cloud (Basic auth); leave blank for Server/DC
